releaseStatus: Experimental alpha.56. Remote on-foot display prediction now blends sender-timed movement with the game's native ped velocity and uses the measured 25 ms native interpolation buffer. Two hidden local native clients measured p95 spacing error of 3.9 cm with no injected delay and 38.6/36.4 cm with simulated 300 ms RTT plus ±30 ms one-way jitter, at about 144 FPS. The transparent name/health marker remains 74 px above the rendered head and aligned below 0.00002 px. These are controlled same-PC tests, not a public internet or cross-ISP guarantee. Vehicle edge cases, full NPC/combat synchronization, and fresh-Windows first-run remain unverified. Each player imports their own legally obtained Vice City files; no original game assets are included.
